patch_description: Increase expressive power targeted at detecting tic-tac-toe winning lines while keeping parameter efficiency. Replace the single shared ZZZ parameter with geometry-aware ZZZ parameters (zzz_row, zzz_col, zzz_diag) and add a doubly-controlled diagonal CCRZ to complement diagonal ZZZs. Keep symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations and the CZ lattice backbone plus the shared center-edge CRZ. This raises params modestly (to ~14 per block) and mirrors a high-performing motif discovered earlier (better line sensitivity with little overparameterization).
